parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State two ways families can be dysfunctional.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain three reasons why cohabitation is increasing.

parts.label: (d)

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Discuss the view that the family is functional.

Your answer should include:

• a conclusion.
